notes: Loop structure and the virtual Deactivate calls match, but the target reloads the element pointer from the array before the call (lwz r3,0(r31)) while the flags check uses a separate register load; MSVC CSEs the two loads in every variant tried (local, cast, volatile flag read), so the extra instruction is missing.

Hard: the target has a 0xC0 frame with this in r31, loop counter in r30, pointer in r29 and the format string in r28, and tests a1[697] through an addic/subfe/clrlwi bool idiom that no source form tried reproduced; the instruction-word percentage is low because a 3-instruction prologue/branch difference shifts every later word.

Iterator loop and the id dispatch layout matched after several tries; the hard part was the 16-bit lane shuffle, which MSVC emits as inslwi/insrwi/extrwi/extlwi only for particular expression forms; the remaining mismatch is the (v<<16)|v copy sequence near offset 0x88-0x90.
Needed the init-flag guard with the heap-null branch and a single merged store through a local result variable; the store-then-return variants produced one extra instruction.
Straightforward squared-distance comparison; the sum was written as dx*dx + (dz*dz + dy*dy) to match the fmadds ordering on the first try.
A 122-slot virtual call was declared with a generated list of dummy virtuals; branch layout (non-null block first, early return 1 at the end) and the (n==6)+1 form were the only issues.

Control flow is right but the target keeps the constant 1 in r29 across calls and returns the bool of an unsigned-char call via a subfic/subfe/and idiom; none of the return forms produced it, so the prologue (savegprlr_29 vs savegprlr_30) and the tail mismatch.
